NBA ‘Jingle Hoops’ Commercial (2013) 🎄 
The 2013 ‘Jingle Hoops’ commercial was the NBA in its festive bag. Derrick Rose, Kevin Durant , Stephen Curry, James Harden, Steve Nash, and LeBron James turning simple jump shots into a Christmas melody. It dropped right as the NBA’s Christmas Day games were becoming must-watch TV, and the ad helped make that whole era feel like an official holiday tradition.
